holisticNarrative.summary:
Practice Fusion's public EHI export documentation is unusually detailed for a b(10) artifact set. The v9 catalog is explicit about manual single-patient and full-practice export and documents a large native table model with field-level names, types, and descriptions. This gives migration teams substantial structural visibility before touching production data.

The strongest practical advantage is breadth across operational domains: encounters, labs, medications, referrals, messaging, insurance, and billing-facing superbill structures are all represented in separate entities rather than compressed into summary objects. That lowers conflation risk and supports domain-by-domain extraction planning.

The main friction is that importer-critical semantics are still under-specified. There is no formal FK/constraint map, sample payloads are missing, and value-set documentation is uneven. These gaps do not invalidate the export, but they shift workload onto implementation teams to infer joins and coded-value behavior carefully.
